Zeno is an AI-powered educational platform designed to make learning smarter, simpler, and more personalized. 

Zeno helps students understand their educational content through smart AI assistance, contextual answers, and tailored learning experiences. Instead of just giving answers, Zeno is designed to help students understand the "why" behind what they learn. 

With technologies like Artificial Intelligence, RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation), and personalized learning systems, Zeno can work with educational materials and provide answers based on the student's actual curriculum. 

Our Vision 

We believe every student should have access to a personal learning assistant available whenever they need it. 

Zeno's goal is to bridge the gap between traditional educational materials and modern artificial intelligence, creating a learning experience featuring: 

🎓 Educational — Focused on true understanding. 
🤖 Smart — Powered by modern AI technologies. 
📚 Context-Aware — Based on the student's educational content. 
🌍 Accessible — Designed to make high-quality learning assistance available to more students. 
✨ Personalized — Adapting the experience to each student's needs. 

Built for Students 

Whether you are reviewing a lesson, preparing for an exam, asking about a difficult concept, or simply trying to understand something better, Zeno is built to be your personal AI learning companion. 

Learn smarter. Understand deeper. Go further with Zeno.

Last updated: August 24, 2026 

At Zeno, we respect your privacy and are committed to protecting your personal data. This Privacy Policy outlines how your data is collected, used, stored, and protected when you use the Zeno platform and services. 

By using Zeno, you agree to the practices described in this policy. 

1. Information We Collect 

We may collect the following information when you use the platform: 

Account Information: Email, password (encrypted), display name, country, grade level, educational system, and preferred language. 
Usage Information: Conversations with Zeno, questions, service consumption, subscription info, session logs, and basic technical details. 
Payment Information: Payment details may be processed through third-party service providers. 

2. How We Use Your Data 

We use the information to create and manage your account, provide Zeno educational services, personalize the learning experience, improve service quality, prevent fraud, and protect platform security. 

3. Artificial Intelligence and Conversations 

Zeno may use artificial intelligence technologies to process questions. We strive to use this data solely to improve the service and do not sell your personal data to third parties. 

4. Educational Content and RAG 

Certain features rely on RAG technologies to access relevant information from educational content to provide more accurate answers. 

5. Data Sharing 

We do not sell your personal data. We may share it with trusted service providers (AI, payment, hosting) to the extent necessary to provide the service. 

6. Data Security 

We take appropriate technical measures to protect your data from unauthorized access, though no method of transmission over the internet is 100% secure. 

7. Account Deletion 

You can request the deletion of your account and personal data at any time. 

8. Your Rights 

You have the right to access, correct, or request deletion of your data in accordance with applicable laws.

Welcome to Zeno. By using the Zeno platform, apps, or services, you agree to comply with the terms of use outlined below. 

1. Service Definition 
Zeno is an educational platform leveraging artificial intelligence technologies to help students learn and understand study materials. 

2. Account Creation 
Portal users are responsible for providing accurate information, maintaining login credentials confidentiality, and not sharing accounts with others. 

3. Use of Artificial Intelligence 
AI responses may occasionally contain errors and are not a replacement for a teacher or official educational resources. 

4. Acceptable Use 
Zeno must be used for lawful purposes. Attempting to hack systems, bypass usage limits, or transmit harmful content is strictly prohibited. 

5. Intellectual Property Rights 
All intellectual property rights related to the Zeno platform remain owned by Zeno or respective rights holders. 

6. Disclaimer of Warranties 
Zeno is provided on an "as is" basis, and we do not guarantee the service will be entirely error-free or uninterrupted. 

7. Suspension or Termination 
We reserve the right to suspend your account if you violate the terms of use or use the service unlawfully.
